verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS work-management product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking opt-out. The Asana-Disable header only switches API deprecation features off per request, which is an unrelated control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
